name: Live, Smile, Explode
source:
It was supposed to be a normal day in school. That is until some maniac announced you're now part of his crazy game and trapped you in a room with three other people. And a bomb. With a timer that's slowly ticking down...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221101000629/https://dragonfan.itch.io/live-smile-explode]Itch.io[/url]]
